poll.question: Hui Ling hears scratching at the ramp—a voice, maybe human. Dan wants it sealed. Does she talk him into opening it?

options.label: Unlock the ramp
options.desc: Hui Ling's mercy wins — let the narrator lean toward her need to help

options.label: Seal it tight
options.desc: Dan's logic holds — narrate his cold math: two alive beats three dead

options.label: Talk before opening
options.desc: Neither fully wins — one tense conversation through the door to decide
